diagonal-stroke.svg: <g><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="100" y2="10" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" /></g>

note.svg: <g><text x="0" y="0" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="{{r_fore-color}}" id="placeholder">{{note}}</text></g>

note-underline.svg: <g><text x="0" y="0" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="{{r_fore-color}}" text-decoration="underline" id="placeholder">{{note}}</text></g>

box.svg: <g><rect x="0" y="0" width="100" height="30" fill="none" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="1" /></g>

arrow-right.svg: <g><path d="M 0 0 L 20 0 L 15 -5 M 20 0 L 15 5" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" fill="none" /></g>

circle-marker.svg: <g><circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="none" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" /></g>

underline.svg: <g><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="100" y2="0" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" /></g>

bracket-left.svg: <g><path d="M 5 0 L 0 0 L 0 30 L 5 30" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" fill="none" /></g>

bracket-right.svg: <g><path d="M 0 0 L 5 0 L 5 30 L 0 30" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" fill="none" /></g>

asterisk.svg: <g><text x="0" y="0" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="{{r_fore-color}}" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle">*</text></g>

checkmark.svg: <g><path d="M 0 5 L 5 10 L 15 0" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" /></g>

cross-mark.svg: <g><line x1="0" y1="0" x2="10" y2="10" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" /><line x1="10" y1="0" x2="0" y2="10" stroke="{{r_fore-color}}" stroke-width="2" /></g>
